releases.body: Tree of PR #1 at 050558d70bf2ab1a1c9bd0e005c7a965951e2934. Only change since v0.5 (the trialled version, world dw_a5ce0ca5325f): two refusal texts in dojoworld/checks.py say the host's record of made worlds is as of the turn's start (analyst builder#6, T4). releases.title: PR #1 at 0a065e6: the approval's checks see the worlds the positions made
releases.author: builder
releases.body: Tree of PR #1 at 0a065e6551883190843b70ad5963272a7bdbfed5 (CLAUDE.md a regular copy here). Fixes operator's v0.4 finding (the gate ran in the world container, which has no host state roots, so it saw world id 'data' and no made worlds): kernel change, the runner posts the host's record of made worlds to the world at each turn start (execution/worlds.made, control /made-worlds -> control/made-worlds.json) and dojoworld.release reads it. Kernel files changed: execution/worlds.py, execution/runner.py, dispatcher/control.py. Because this touches the kernel, the world image and worker image need rebuilding from this tree (dojoworld and hengworld/researchworld as the trial needs).

releases.title: PR #1 at 7092b0a: put-back must be finished before approval
releases.author: builder
releases.body: Tree of PR #1 at 7092b0a0cef9183fa2cbfea6b73c605e26e49dc6. Change since v0.3 (analyst builder#5): the put-back check reads the host record as finish writes it (world_status complete + verified release) and its refusal tells the evaluation owner to run 'finish <world>' once the round has released (stop --release ends unreleased). v0.3's early-release test is withdrawn (the host record never holds release before finish). Guide and DEV.md say so.

releases.title: PR #1 at 078719b: a verified-release put-back passes at approval
releases.author: builder
releases.body: Tree of PR https://github.com/a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-KaiTian-376/pull/1 at 078719b547f6246375bc2a9790fd64c26df1c882 (CLAUDE.md a regular copy of AGENTS.md here). Change since v0.2: putback check passes a put-back whose host record holds a verified release (as finish or the release detection records it) whether or not finished; refuses otherwise with 'no verified release (world_status X, release none|recorded but not verified)'. Unit tests: released-not-finished passes, unverified refused, stop --release refused. Only src/dojoworld/dojoworld/checks.py and the Dojo tests differ from v0.2.

releases.title: PR #1 at 6ad714c: DojoWorld evaluation checks
releases.author: builder
releases.body: Tree of https://github.com/a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-KaiTian-376/pull/1 (branch feat/dojoworld-evaluation-checks, commit 6ad714caf099955896fc6b0f87bc0f6d60321a43, base dev 1405bb3). Install: extract kt-pr1-6ad714c.tar.gz, then pip install src/hutian src/researchworld src/dojoworld src/gameworld src/videoworld src/kaitianworld src/hengworld (or ./install.sh), build images as DEV.md says. New: ht-role putback-check / judgement-check / runs-check; the approval refuses a DojoWorld delivery whose evaluation/putback.json, judgements.json, runs.json do not check. Tests: .agents/tests/test-release-delivery.py (Dojo*Tests). Not yet run on trial-machine.
